answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
